kinds.d: Fixed flight of steps linking floors of a home, with treads, strings and a handrail.
Chair or platform that carries a person up and down a staircase on a rail fixed to the stairs.

kinds.d: Small passenger lift for a house, travelling through a floor aperture or in a shaft.

brands.d: Family-owned lift maker founded in London by Joseph Stannah, now based in Andover, Hampshire.
Stairlift maker in Steeton, West Yorkshire, building straight, curved and outdoor stairlifts in UK factories.
Stairlift brand offering straight, curved and outdoor models; made its first European stairlift in 1961; sold within the Savaria range.
Accessibility company in Laval, Quebec, making home elevators, through-floor lifts, stairlifts and platform lifts.
Through-floor home lift maker in Kingswinford, West Midlands, building its lifts in its own factory.
